Here are two reliable sources confirming that the Charter of the United Nations was adopted in 1945 (with exact dates):

1) United Nations — "UN Charter" (official UN page). States the Charter was signed at the San Francisco conference on 26 June 1945 and came into force on 24 October 1945. ([un.org](https://www.un.org/en/about-us/un-charter?utm_source=openai))

2) U.S. National Archives — "United Nations Charter" (milestone documents). Notes the Charter was signed on June 26, 1945, in San Francisco and that the required ratifications made it come into force on October 24, 1945. ([archives.gov](https://www.archives.gov/milestone-documents/united-nations-charter?utm_source=openai))

If you’d like, I can also provide a direct PDF of the Charter text (the treaty publication) or a citation to a scholarly reference (e.g., Britannica) for further corroboration.
